text: On matched seeds 24-26, the N=64-to-N=128 force decline is entirely in trained R2, but the N=128-to-N=256 decline splits about evenly between falling trained R2 (0.02-0.06) and rising controls (0.03-0.04). Does the same split hold on data_seed 1 and on seeds 20-23 under the current pipeline? And does the control part disappear under a control pool shared across N?
